result.summary: Found 3 issues: content is cut off at the right edge of the horizontal scroll section, one card title is truncated, and the layout is cut off at the bottom without full spacing.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section is cut off at the right edge, showing a partial third card (Trattoria Piccol...) with no visual indication of scrollability
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial card peek indicator to signal horizontal scroll is available, or ensure cards are fully visible with clear scroll affordance

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' appears truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' due to card cutoff at screen edge
issues.suggestion: Ensure text truncates gracefully with ellipsis or adjust card width so names aren't awkwardly cut by the screen boundary

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom of the page is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing partial 'Popular right now' content
issues.suggestion: Adjust the scrollable content area or add bottom padding so cards aren't awkwardly clipped by the fixed navigation bar
